title: BARRAGE x
features:
Advanced Mechanics
Adaptive Hitbox Extender: Dynamically scales for spikes, bumps, and dives.
Smart Aim Auto-Spike: Automatically identifies and targets gaps in enemy defense.
Precision Auto-Bump: Faces the open court for strategic ball placement.
Intelligent Auto-Dive: Instantly tracks and dives toward landing zones.
Seamless Combos: Integrated Dive + Bump automation for perfect resets.


Visual Intelligence
Tactical ESP: Full visibility for Ball, Players, Clones, and Enemy Jumps.
Trajectory Tracking: Real-time path projection for high-accuracy plays.
Court Visuals: Enhanced court line clarity and spatial awareness.
Movement & Physics
Athletic Mods: Adjustable Walk Speed and Jump Power with style auto-detection.
Air Control: Access to Gravity Boost, Directional Jumping, and enhanced Air Movement.


Automation & System
Efficiency Tools: Auto-Serve, Auto-Queue, Auto-Rejoin, and Anti-AFK.
Config Management: Full Save/Load support for personalized settings.
